subject: Request: bend the rate card for Cedar Analytics — proposed commit ladder
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cedaranalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@cedaranalytics.com>, Tom Halstead <tom.halstead@cedaranalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing — long term commit and request for a laddered unit price

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Cedar really liked the latency and the KV cache behavior. We ran some internal numbers and want to talk about a committed program for hosted API usage. High level:
- Estimated starting volume: 12B tokens/month, growing to ~35B by month 9.
- We're looking for a 12–18 month contract with quarterly commit tranches.
- Target blended unit: something substantially below published rate card — we need a path to ~$0.0005/token at scale to hit our economics.

Attached is a short forecast and the one-page MOU our procurement team prefers to start with (Cedar_MA_proposal_v2.pdf).

Questions:
1) Do you support a laddered commit (e.g., 0–10B, 10–25B, 25B+) with stepped per-token pricing?
2) What approvals are required to deviate from the retail rate card?
3) Any discounts tied to longer lock-in (18 vs 12 months)?

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Data Platforms
Cedar Analytics
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cedaranalytics.com>
Cc: Tom Halstead <tom.halstead@cedaranalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing — long term commit and request for a laddered unit price

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. I reviewed the attached and had a quick chat with pricing ops. Quick answers up front: yes, we can do laddered commits; yes, we can offer deeper discounts for longer terms; and yes, any material deviation from the published rate card requires an internal approval (pricing committee / revenue ops sign-off).

Proposed next steps:
- I can put together a draft commit ladder and blended price that meets your ~$0.0005/token target at top tier, but we’ll need a minimum 12-month firm commit and a performance-based true-up.
- I’ll loop in our pricing approver and commercial lead to get internal guidance on what’s approvable without executive sign-off.

Can you confirm 1) whether the token volumes are monthly or aggregated across models, and 2) whether any PII or private models are in scope (affects private deployment vs hosted SLA).

If you’re free tomorrow at 10:30 PT, let’s hop on a 30-min alignment call.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cedar Analytics — pricing ask (deal DEAL-4892) — need price exception guidance

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Cedar's request. Key points:
- Account: Cedar Analytics (mid-market, strong MRR potential).
- Forecast: 12B -> 35B tokens/month over 9 months (see attached forecast).
- External ask: blended per-token target ~$0.0005 at top tier with 12–18 month commitment and laddered pricing.
- Attachments: Cedar_MA_proposal_v2.pdf, usage_forecast_2026Q3.xlsx

Specific ask: can pricing ops approve a 40–55% deviation from our public rate card for a laddered commit, or does this escalate to commercial leadership / CFO? They are sensitive to unit economics; if we can offer a phased ladder that hits their target by month 6–9 we can likely win and expand.

Notes: they will remain on hosted API; no private deployment requested as of now. No obvious security blockers.

Please advise next steps and any required approvals — if you can provide a draft commit ladder I’ll present it to Cedar on Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cedar Analytics — pricing ask (deal DEAL-4892) — need price exception guidance

Marcus — thanks for the context and the numbers. High level:
- We can entertain a laddered program but two conditions are non-negotiable: 1) a contractual minimum commit (start at 12B/month guaranteed for the first 3 months), and 2) a quarterly usage true-up clause to prevent leakage.
- For the $0.0005/token target, that implies ~55% discount at the highest tier versus our published G2 model rates — that’s beyond what pricing ops can greenlight autonomously. This needs AM + Commercial Director approval and a finance quick look.

I’ll draft a suggested ladder we can present to Cedar:
Tier A (0–10B): $0.0012/token (baseline commit discount)
Tier B (10–25B): $0.00078/token
Tier C (25B+): $0.00052/token (conditional on 12–18 month term + quarterly revenue true-ups)

If Karthik and finance sign off on the blended math we can route this as a commercial exception (approx. impact: ~30–40% blended discount across first 6 months if growth materializes). Marissa.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cedar Analytics — pricing ask (deal DEAL-4892) — need price exception guidance

Agree with Marissa's framing. A few operational notes before we send the commercial exception: 
1) Add a clause for early termination fee if monthly usage drops >40% below committed run-rate for two consecutive quarters.
2) Require a one-time onboarding credit (capped) to cover initial integration work, not counted against committed tokens.
3) We should include an automatic rollback to standard rate card if usage is fraud-flagged or redirected via unfixed endpoints.

If Marcus can incorporate these items into a short-term proposal, I’ll fast-track commercial director approval pending finance sign-off.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
